name: 에이전트 클럽하우스
description: 여러 coding agent가 한 대화에 참여하는 방. agents plugin의 정의에서 고른 member가 owned terminal session으로 시작하고, 방은 화자 label과 turn 규칙을 알린 뒤 mode와 @이름 mention에 따라 메시지를 전달한다.

kibitzDefault.label: 대화 기본 모드
kibitzDefault.description: 새 방의 대화 방식. 순차는 roster 순서로 member마다 차례로, 진행은 session이 idle인 첫 member가, 동시는 모든 member가 동시에 받는다. @이름 mention은 mention된 member에게만 보낸다.

conversationTurns.label: 대화 turn 한도
conversationTurns.description: owner 메시지 하나에서 member의 @이름 mention이 시작하는 turn의 최대 수. 그 수만큼 진행되면 방은 relay를 끝내고 대화에 그 사실을 적는다. 0이면 mention이 turn을 시작하지 않는다.

status.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.arrangement
status.description: How the room arranged its member cards: idle before any arrangement, group when the room card and the member cards form one group card, tabs with the reason of the layout plan when the members open as tabs, and error with the reason of a refused layout command.

status.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.conversation
status.description: The conversation that the room shows: the entries of the room record in record order, speaker being owner, the identifier of a member, or clubhouse for a line of the room, and each member whose turn the room waits for, with its step (protocol until the protocol turn ends, answer until the answer arrives, record until the record acknowledgement arrives) and the program state of its session in core.sessions (null while core reports none, ended when core.sessions no longer lists it), and each session of the closing delivery with its delivered number, the record length and whether it waits for its next idle.

status.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.transport
status.description: Whether the room can reach its members, with the reason when it cannot. The room has no member transport until the owned sessions and the terminal relay are in place, so its state is unavailable.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.state
commands.description: Return the live state of the room: the conversation mode, the roster with the check state of each member, and the transport status.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.member.set
commands.description: Check or uncheck the roster member id; checking invites it and summons its session. Setting the current state changes nothing.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.member.move
commands.description: Move the roster member id to the place index, counted from 0.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.mode.set
commands.description: Set the conversation mode of the room: facil, turn or simul.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.message.send
commands.description: Relay a message to the members by the mode and the mentions, let the members that answers mention take further turns up to the setting conversationTurns, and answer after the whole conversation with the answer of each member in turn order.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.conversation.stop
commands.description: End the conversation of the message that the room relays after the turns that have started, and end each wait for a record acknowledgement; refused when no message is relayed and no record wait is open. A second call changes nothing.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.answer
commands.description: Deliver the answer of a member for the turn whose token its relayed line carries as [@clubhouse] turn <token>; run it with the surface of the room. Each token takes one answer while its turn is open.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.record.ack
commands.description: Acknowledge a record line of the room whose token it carries as [@clubhouse] record <token>; run it with the surface of the room and answer nothing. Each token takes one acknowledgement while it is open.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.tower.set
commands.description: Open the control tower modal when open is true and close it when open is false. Setting the current state changes nothing.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.tower.plan
commands.description: Turn a natural-language request into a validated command, DOM and status plan, returned as a dry run unless commit is true.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.tower.reflect
commands.description: Plan, dispatch and verify a natural-language request, re-planning on failure up to a cap, then escalate.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.tower.trace
commands.description: Return the persisted plan and step history of the control tower, newest first, or the steps of one plan.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.tower.scan
commands.description: Scan untrusted text and plan steps for injection signatures and report the verdict.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.tower.macro
commands.description: Save, run, list, forget or propose a named control-tower macro.

element.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.send
element.description: Send button: runs message.send with the text of the input. Disabled while the transport status is unavailable.

element.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.stop
element.description: Stop button: runs conversation.stop, which ends the conversation after the turns that have started and the record waits. Enabled only while a message is relayed or a record wait is open.

element.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.input
element.description: Message input field: Enter without Shift runs message.send with its text. Disabled while the transport status is unavailable.

element.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.tab
element.description: Roster tab of a member: a click runs member.set with the toggled state, a drag over another tab runs member.move

element.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.mode
element.description: Conversation mode buttons (facilitator, sequential, simultaneous): each runs mode.set with its mode

element.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.tower
element.description: Control tower button: runs tower.set with the state opposite to the current one, opening or closing the control tower modal (natural-language input, dry run, command templates, search, graph)
